_comment: Single source of truth for webfonts. build.py reads this to create the assets/fonts/ folders, generate src/css/fonts.css and assets/fonts/MANIFEST.md, and validate everything. Edit here, never in the generated files.

families.terminology: 'Display' is GT Sectra's large-size optical cut (the family also ships GT Sectra and GT Sectra Fine). It is not a weight. The CSS family name is 'GT Sectra Display'; the foundry style name maps straight to a CSS weight: Regular = 400.

faces.used_for: h1 and h2 display headings: hero lines, section titles, case-study titles, the closing statement
Single emphasised words inside display headings (<em> within h1/h2)

families.terminology: 'Standard' is GT America's width subfamily (alongside Compressed, Condensed, Extended, Expanded and Mono). It is not a weight. The CSS family name is 'GT America Standard'; Regular = 400, Medium = 500.

faces.used_for: Body copy, lead paragraphs, form input text, legal pages
<em> in running text (the privacy and terms pages use whole emphasised sentences, kept verbatim)
h3/h4 subheads, buttons, navigation, <strong>, form labels

families.terminology: 'Mono' is GT America's monospaced width subfamily. The CSS family name is 'GT America Mono'; Regular = 400.

faces.used_for: Eyebrow labels, badges, metadata rail, section indices, stack lists, step counters, timestamps, footer colophon
